description: This source file contains unit tests for the GatewayNodeSession component of the OpenClawKit project. It includes mock classes for WebSocket interactions, helper extensions, and various test cases for connection handling, token management, URL normalization, and event stream behaviors.

classes.name: FakeGatewayWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock implementation of URLSessionWebSocketTask used for testing WebSocket interactions.

classes.name: FakeGatewayWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocket session that manages multiple FakeGatewayWebSocketTask instances.

classes.name: SeqGapProbe
classes.description: An actor used to detect when a sequence gap event occurs during WebSocket reconnection.

methods.name: withLock
methods.description: A thread-safe extension for NSLock to execute a closure while holding the lock.
